_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Weapons.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

AlexsBat_Description.chinese: 亚历克斯赢得大满贯的棒球棍。
AlexsBat_Description.english: The baseball bat Alex won a grand slam with.

BoneSword_Description.chinese: 磨尖的骨头打造的轻剑。
BoneSword_Description.english: A light sword made of sharpened bone.

BrokenTrident_Description.english: It comes from the ocean, and is still sharp.

BurglarsShank_Description.chinese: 身手敏捷、行动隐秘的人首选之武器。
BurglarsShank_Description.english: The weapon of choice for the agile and stealthy.

CrystalDagger_Description.english: This knife is made of pure quartz.

DragontoothClub_Description.chinese: 这根棍子是用一颗充满魔力的牙齿锻造而成的。
DragontoothClub_Description.english: This club was forged from a tooth full of magic.

DragontoothCutlass_Description.chinese: 这把刀是用一颗充满魔力的牙齿锻造而成的。
DragontoothCutlass_Description.english: This knife was forged from a tooth full of magic.

DragontoothShiv_Description.chinese: 这把刀是用一颗充满魔力的牙齿锻造而成的。
DragontoothShiv_Description.english: This knife was forged from a tooth full of magic.

DwarfDagger_Description.chinese: 它很古老，但刃锋未曾变钝。
DwarfDagger_Description.english: It is very old, but the blade's edge has never dulled.

DwarfHammer_Description.chinese: 它会发出微弱的嗡嗡声。
DwarfHammer_Description.english: It gives off a faint humming sound.

DwarfSword_Description.chinese: 很古老，但剑锋未曾变钝。
DwarfSword_Description.english: Very old, but the sword's edge has never dulled.

ElfBlade_Description.chinese: 唯有精灵的巧手才能打造出这件物品。
ElfBlade_Description.english: Only the skilled hands of an elf could forge this item.

ElliottsPencil_Description.chinese: 艾利欧特用它来写书。非常尖锐！
ElliottsPencil_Description.english: Elliott used it to write books. Very sharp!

Femur_Description.chinese: 一根古老沉重的骨头，覆盖着数个世纪的尘垢。
Femur_Description.english: An ancient, heavy bone, covered in centuries of grime.

ForestSword_Description.chinese: 由森林魔法打造的强力之剑。
ForestSword_Description.english: A powerful sword forged by forest magic.

GalaxyDagger_Description.english: You've never heard of such a thing.

GalaxyHammer_Description.chinese: 用一种你闻所未闻的超轻材料打造而成。
GalaxyHammer_Description.english: Forged from an ultra-light material you've never heard of.

segments.gloss: unrivalled (lit. who could contend with it)

GoldenScythe_Description.chinese: 它比传统的镰刀更强大。
GoldenScythe_Description.english: It is more powerful than a traditional scythe.

HaleysIron_Description.chinese: 非常烫手，散发着跟海莉的头发一样的味道。
HaleysIron_Description.english: Very hot to the touch, gives off the same smell as Haley's hair.

HarveysMallet_Description.english: Makes people think of Harvey's clinic.

HolyBlade_Description.english: Held in the hand, it's full of positive energy.

InfinityBlade_Description.english: The true form of the Galaxy Sword.

InfinityDagger_Description.english: The true form of the Galaxy Dagger.

InfinityGavel_Description.english: The true form of the Galaxy Hammer.

IridiumNeedle_Description.chinese: 其尖锐超出想象，甚至微观到原子层面也是无比尖锐。
IridiumNeedle_Description.english: Its sharpness is beyond imagination; even down to the atomic level it is incomparably sharp.

IridiumScythe_Description.chinese: 可以收割所有作物，收集干草效果极佳。
IridiumScythe_Description.english: Can harvest all crops; extremely effective at gathering hay.

LavaKatana_Description.chinese: 用火山熔岩打造的强大刀刃。
LavaKatana_Description.english: A powerful blade forged with volcanic lava.

LeahsWhittler_Description.chinese: 莉亚用来削木的最爱工具。
LeahsWhittler_Description.english: Leah's favorite tool for whittling wood.

MarusWrench_Description.chinese: 巨大的金属扳手。闻起来很有玛鲁的味道。
MarusWrench_Description.english: A huge metal wrench. Smells very much of Maru.

Meowmere_Description.english: A rare weapon from another world...

NeptunesGlaive_Description.english: An heirloom from the Gem Sea.

OssifiedBlade_Description.chinese: 由骨头形成的巨大而锋利的剑刃。
OssifiedBlade_Description.english: A huge, sharp sword blade formed from bone.

PennysFryer_Description.chinese: 潘妮最爱的煎锅。里面凝固着一些胶状物。
PennysFryer_Description.english: Penny's favorite frying pan. Some gunk has set inside it.

PiratesSword_Description.chinese: 看上去曾经是一位海盗的武器。
PiratesSword_Description.english: Looks like it was once a pirate's weapon.

SamsOldGuitar_Description.english: Worn and down on its luck.

Scythe_Description.chinese: 如果你建了一个筒仓，它可以割草以及收获干草。
Scythe_Description.english: If you've built a silo, it can cut grass and harvest hay.

SebsLostMace_Description.chinese: 塞巴斯蒂安的中世纪仿制品之一。

SebsLostMace_Name.chinese: 塞巴斯蒂安的遗失之锤

ShadowDagger_Description.chinese: 把刀放到耳旁，能听见千百条灵魂的哀嚎。
ShadowDagger_Description.english: Put the knife by your ear and you can hear the wailing of a thousand souls.

TemperedBroadsword_Description.chinese: 看上去能够抵挡任何东西。

TemplarsBlade_Description.chinese: 曾属于一位高尚的圣殿骑士。
TemplarsBlade_Description.english: Once belonged to a noble Templar knight.

TheSlammer_Description.chinese: 超级重的锤子，能够击飞敌人。
TheSlammer_Description.english: A super-heavy hammer that can knock enemies flying.

WickedKris_Description.chinese: 使用铱合金打造的刀刃。
WickedKris_Description.english: A blade forged from iridium alloy.

WoodClub_Description.chinese: 沉重的木，粗糙地打造成棍子的型状。
WoodClub_Description.english: Heavy wood, crudely made into the shape of a club.

WoodMallet_Description.chinese: 坚固的头部威力强大。对于一把棍棒来说，重量有点轻。
WoodMallet_Description.english: The solid head is very powerful. For a club, it's a little light.

WoodenBlade_Description.chinese: 对于一块木雕来说不错了。
WoodenBlade_Description.english: For a piece of wood carving, not bad.
